first_step_test: Two long connected wooden rails at a diagonal give the learner the full length and jaw position without a loose guide.

source.notes: Five-panel handmade graphite contact sheet; review before cropping.

final_elements.name: upper wooden rail
final_elements.description: Long upper tapered wooden half from lower-left handle to upper-right jaw.

final_elements.name: lower wooden rail
final_elements.description: Parallel lower wooden half meeting the upper half at the pinched jaw.

final_elements.name: jaw notch
final_elements.description: Short V opening at the upper-right biting end.

final_elements.name: coil spring
final_elements.description: Small metal spiral centered where the rails cross.

final_elements.name: spring arms
final_elements.description: Two short metal wire arms touching their respective wooden rails.

final_elements.name: wood grain
final_elements.description: A few short strokes following each wood rail.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: One broken shadow beneath the lower-left handle.

frames.visible_job: Draw both wooden halves at their fixed diagonal and leave a small center gap.
frames.instruction: Draw two long tapered wooden halves on one rising diagonal, keeping their lower-left handles apart and their upper-right jaw ends close.
At the narrow upper-right tip, draw a short V bite between the two rails without shifting either handle.

frames.visible_job: Add the central coil and two attached metal arms.
frames.instruction: At the crossing near the middle, sketch one small wire spiral and extend one wire arm onto each wooden half.

frames.visible_job: Add grain and the short ground shadow.
frames.instruction: Add a few short grain strokes within each wooden half, then put one broken shadow under the lower-left handle.

final_step.visible_job: Darken established graphite contours and shade the same rails, coil, and shadow without adding structure.
final_step.instruction: Use 2B to shade the established wooden rails lightly, darken the coil and its two arms, and soften the existing ground shadow.
